## Overrides applied

*(none)*

## Overrides ignored

*(none)*

## Soft-fails / out-of-band

- `.env.test unreadable` — a secret-file guard stopped the evaluator from reading or sourcing `.env.test`. `DATABASE_URL` came from the CLAUDE.md local-Postgres URL (`postgres://tasks:***@localhost:5432/...`), which reaches the same PostgreSQL 16 container. The `Tests` gate ran with `DATABASE_URL` pointed at the ephemeral DB, so the `#[sqlx::test]` databases were created on that server.
- `harness correction` — the first pass of `API-PAGE-01` recorded `Content-Type` as missing because the evaluator's header lookup was case-sensitive (axum sends `content-type`). `curl -si` showed `content-type: application/json`. After the harness was fixed, all 40 items were re-run against freshly reset state. The verdicts above come from that second pass.
- `API-PERF-01 timing` — 20 warm-up requests ran first and were not counted. Of the 1,000 measured sequential requests against the release build: p50 2.13 ms, p95 3.77 ms, max 12.80 ms.
- `parallel siblings` — F05/F07/F08 worktrees were running at the same time. Services used random free ports and a uniquely named DB. No collisions were observed.

## Abort reason

*(none)*
